info.name: Emerald Housing - Option B
info.description: Run Option B - Automated verification in order, or run scripts/run-postman-option-b.cjs. Captures IDs, CSRF tokens, ETags and independent sessions automatically. Creates uniquely named test records and disables its test accounts; never modifies existing business records. Outage/load/HTTPS demonstrations remain opt-in manual reference requests.

item.name: Manual reference (opt-in)
item.description: Original exploratory requests, including deliberate outages/load and optional HTTPS. Skipped unless runManualRequests is true. Run selected requests only after preparing their documented prerequisites.

item.name: Authentication - Step 7
item.description: Manual session login and CSRF workflow. No Postman scripts are added. The client cookie jar carries the HttpOnly SESSION cookie; copy CSRF response tokens manually.

request.description: Run before login and again after login. Copy the response token into the csrfToken environment variable. Postman should retain the XSRF-TOKEN cookie.

Log in with the privately provisioned administrator. Expected: 200 and minimal admin identity. Invalid credentials: 401. Do not save a real password in an exported collection/environment. Login rotates the session ID and clears the old CSRF token; fetch a new CSRF token after success. Repeated login attempts share a Redis-backed unauthenticated bucket; after the configured burst is exhausted, expect 429 with Retry-After. If the shared limiter is unavailable, login fails closed with 503.
Reads the current admin identity from the SESSION cookie. Expected: 200 when logged in; 401 without a valid session.
First clear cookies for localhost in Postman, then send this request. Expected: 401. Do not run while a valid SESSION cookie is present.
Run while logged in, with cookies present, but intentionally omit X-XSRF-TOKEN. Expected: 403 and no member is created.
End the current session. Run after fetching a fresh CSRF token. Expected: 200; subsequent Get Current Admin should return 401.

Returns Emerald Housing Society details. Expected: 200 OK with societyId, societyName, and totalFloors. For the Step 9 manual limiter demonstration, send a short burst as the authenticated admin; requests above the configured bucket may receive 429. Normal calls are not expected to be rejected.

Returns the 18 floor records ordered from 1 to 18. Expected: 200 OK and an array of {"floorNumber": number} records. Each Society Pod attempts a startup warmup; if cold, the first read loads PostgreSQL and populates dedicated redis-cache. Repeat to observe a hit. Cache TTL is 10 minutes with up to 30 seconds of downward jitter. On cache Redis outage, fallback database loads are limited to 16 concurrent per Pod; overload returns 503 CACHE_FALLBACK_OVERLOADED.
Looks up the floor selected by the floorNumber environment variable. Values 1 through 18 return 200 OK; an integer outside that range returns 404.
Demonstrates a numeric floor outside the configured 1Ã¢â‚¬â€œ18 range. Expected: 404 Not Found with code RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND and the common JSON error fields.
Direct diagnostic only. Health endpoints are intentionally not published through the NGINX external route; use the documented port-forward or kubectl health checks.

item.name: GET Society Cache Redis Memory Ratio

request.description: Direct Society diagnostic; sign in as Admin first so Postman has the SESSION cookie. Expected: Actuator metric response with the cache Redis used/max memory ratio, sampled every 30 seconds. Review per Pod and configure alert thresholds in your metrics platform; this request does not create alerts. Metrics may be unavailable before Society is updated with the Phase 10 changes.

Direct Society diagnostic; sign in as Admin first so Postman has the SESSION cookie. Shows bounded per-Pod cache-key access gauges (key_hash tags, at most 256 tracked keys per Pod). Compare across Society Pods to spot a disproportionately popular key. This provides visibility; it does not automatically replicate or rebalance hot keys.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Creates an active member. Expected: 201 Created, a Location header, and a response containing the generated memberId, normalized fields, ACTIVE status, createdAt, and updatedAt. Manually copy memberId into the selected environment's memberId variable for later requests. The default mobile format is a 10-digit Indian number beginning 6Ã¢â‚¬â€œ9; the number must not already belong to an active member.
Lists members persisted by Member Service in member_db. Expected: 200 OK and a JSON array; an empty database returns []. Results are ordered by creation time descending.
Retrieves the member whose UUID is stored in memberId. Expected: 200 OK with MemberResponse; 404 if that UUID is not present; 400 if it is not a valid UUID.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Replaces the permitted member fields. Expected: 200 OK. memberId and createdAt remain unchanged; updatedAt is server generated. Use an unused mobile number if changing it, or the same number currently owned by this member.

request.description: Logically deactivates the member and retains the record. Expected: 200 OK with status INACTIVE. Repeating the operation is idempotent and does not change updatedAt after the first transition.

Returns a PageResponse. Page is zero-based, size must be 1-100. Expected: 200.

item.name: Idempotency - Step 9
item.description: Manual durable idempotency examples. The key is retained for 24 hours by default. No automated Postman scripts are included.

item.name: POST Create Member With Idempotency Key

request.description: Send after login and fetching a fresh CSRF token. Use a mobile number not already assigned to an active member. Expected: 201 and Idempotency-Replayed: false. The key is scoped to your authenticated admin and CREATE_MEMBER operation.

Repeat the first request with the exact same key and payload. Expected: 201, same memberId and Idempotency-Replayed: true; no second member is inserted. The durable record expires after 24 hours by default.

item.name: POST Reuse Idempotency Key With Different Payload

request.description: After the first request has committed, reuse its key with a different payload. Expected: 409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT and no extra member. This is a manual example; do not use it as a normal create request.

item.description: Run these scenarios manually and inspect the status and JSON body. Dependency outage scenarios require stopping Society Service yourself; requests do not control service processes. Resilience thresholds and per-pod circuit state are described in README Step 9.

Requires controlled concurrent load beyond SOCIETY_BULKHEAD_MAX_CONCURRENT. Expected 503 SOCIETY_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED, with no membership saved. Do not run as a single request and do not use production traffic for this demonstration.

After admin login, send a short burst from the same client. The shared route limiter is keyed by authenticated admin and may return 429 when its burst is exhausted. Do not treat a single request as expected to be limited.

item.name: Phase 3 - Society Flat API
item.description: Society Service owns all flat records. Create a flat once, then copy flatId from its response. A flat number is selected by the developer; no arbitrary flat inventory is seeded.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Create a configured flat on a valid floor. Expected 201 with flatId, flatNumber, floorId, floorNumber and status. Duplicate flat numbers in this society return 409. Copy flatId into the environment for subsequent calls.

Lists configured flats, sorted by flat number. Expected 200 and an array. Empty flat inventory is valid. This response uses the dedicated Society cache Redis with a 5-minute base TTL and up to 30 seconds of downward jitter. A Redis miss uses PostgreSQL; a distributed per-key lock coordinates concurrent Society Pods.

Admin reference read: expected 200 with flatId, flatNumber, floorId, floorNumber and status; response echoes X-Correlation-ID. This Admin read is cached in dedicated redis-cache for a 2-minute base TTL with up to 30 seconds of downward jitter. Member Service's authenticated flat-assignment validation deliberately takes an uncached authoritative database path.

Syntactically valid but unknown flat UUID. Expected 404 with the Society service's structured RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND error. Repeat within 30 seconds: the Admin cached-read path uses a short-lived negative marker, so PostgreSQL is not queried again. Member assignment validation does not use this negative cache.
Invalid UUID path value. Expected 400 with a structured INVALID_REQUEST response.
Returns a PageResponse. Allowed sortBy values: flatNumber, status, createdAt, updatedAt. Expected: 200; invalid paging/sort gives 400.

Returns flats on the selected floor in flat-number order. Expected: 200; unknown floor gives 404. Uses dedicated redis-cache with a 5-minute base TTL and up to 30 seconds of downward jitter. On simultaneous cold misses, Society Pods coordinate through a short Redis lock; a waiter can load without caching after its 2-second wait expires.
Paginated/sorted flats on the selected floor. Expected: 200.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Updates the flat number and floor while preserving its ID and audit creation time. Expected: 200; invalid data 400; duplicate flat number 409. Cache invalidation runs after commit for the flat ID, negative marker, all-flats list, and affected old/new floor lists. Repeat GET Flat By ID and GET Flats By Floor to observe fresh data.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Marks the flat INACTIVE and retains it for historical references. Repeated calls are idempotent. Expected: 200. Step 10 invalidates the affected flat and floor-list caches only after commit.

item.name: Phase 3 - Member Flat Membership
item.description: Member Service calls Society Service before saving membership. Create/select a member and create/select a flat first. Set correlationId to a safe value such as demo-assign-001.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Validates the member locally, calls Society GET /api/v1/flats/{flatId} through the uncached authoritative validation path, then writes locally. Expected 201 with membershipId/memberId/flatId/relationshipType/startDate. 404 if member or flat is missing, 409 for inactive member or duplicate relationship, 502/503/504 for dependency errors. Redis cache availability or stale data cannot create a false successful assignment; a failed flat/dependency check is never persisted.
Lists membership history for the selected member. Expected 200 with an array of membership response records.
Lists membership records associated with this external flat UUID. Expected 200 with an array.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Run after a successful identical assignment. Expected 409 DUPLICATE_MEMBERSHIP. No extra active membership row is created.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Society Service authoritative validation returns 404, which Member Service maps to 404 FLAT_NOT_FOUND. This remains a 404 even if an ordinary cached read was made earlier. No membership is saved.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Manual scenario: stop Society Service before sending. Expected 503 SOCIETY_SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE and no membership write. Redis-cached admin reference data cannot make this assignment succeed because Member Service uses authoritative uncached validation. Restart Society afterward. This request does not stop the service automatically.
Run while Society is stopped. Expected 200 from Member Service's own database; member retrieval does not call Society.
Returns member membership history in PageResponse form. Expected: 200; missing member 404.
Returns flat membership history in PageResponse form. Expected: 200.

header.description: Current CSRF token from Authentication -> Get CSRF Token.

request.description: Sets an end date and preserves the membership row. Use a date on/after startDate and not in the future. Repeated call retains the original end date. Expected: 200; invalid date 400; unknown member/membership 404.

item.name: Gateway - Step 6
item.description: For a local Gateway process, set gatewayBaseUrl to http://localhost:8080. For Kubernetes, run `kubectl port-forward service/api-gateway 8080:8080 -n emerald-housing`; keep that terminal open and use the same URL. Stop the port-forward with Ctrl+C. API requests use externalBaseUrl; the NGINX HTTPS example uses edgeBaseUrl.

request.description: Direct diagnostic only. Health endpoints are intentionally not published through the NGINX external route; use the documented port-forward or kubectl health checks.

item.name: Phase 19 - Membership Concurrency
item.description: Use an active member, valid flat, current session/CSRF token, and no active membership for the same member, flat, and relationship type. Open A and B in separate tabs and send them nearly simultaneously. Expect one 201 and one 409. Sequential sends only confirm duplicate protection, not overlap. The database row lock serializes competing writes and the unique index is the final guard.

request.description: Send at the same time as Concurrent Assignment B with identical member, flat, and relationship values. Manually expect one request in the pair to return 201 and the other 409.
